title: coral-reef-utac — P114: NOAA's real coral-bleaching threshold system, honestly presented
description: NOAA Coral Reef Watch's real, official Degree Heating Week (DHW) coral-bleaching threshold system (0-20°C-weeks, 5 alert levels), the real escalating series of four documented global bleaching events (Hughes et al. 2017/2018, NOAA 2024: 21% → 37% → 68% → 83.7% of reef area affected), a real thermal-acidification synergy (Guillermic et al. 2021), and Walker et al. 2023 (the honesty check: bleaching resistance varies by genotype with real fitness tradeoffs). Deliberately no UTAC/CREP/AFET bridge and no invented Gamma value -- see DISCLAIMER.md for why an external AI session's proposed Gamma values and other claims did not survive independent verification. Updated 2026-09-02 with an independent, much larger confirmation from GCRMN & ICRI's "Status of Coral Reefs of the World: 2025" report (21.1M observations, 36,886 sites): global coral cover down 9.5% since 1980-2009, with the recovery window between severe events now converging with Hughes 2018's earlier estimate (5-6 years vs. a 6-year median). Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem (P114, domain: climate / ocean ecology).
